purpose: Teach: 貴文/幸雄/十郎/洋一/博之/一夫/僕達/がわり

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「貴文おじさんと旅行に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying he wants to take a trip with Uncle Takafumi.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gentle lilt on Sho's name. Relaying information with a soft smile in the voice, like sharing something she thinks he'll enjoy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのお友達の幸雄おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad's friend Uncle Yukio today.
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Clean attack on the opening word. Slight breathless quality — eager to tell his news. Natural, unstudied rhythm of a six-year-old who wants to be listened to.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「十郎さんは寡黙な方」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father mentioned that Juro is a quiet sort of person.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational. Gentle downward inflection. Speaking as if she's turning something over in her mind while she tells him. Warm but measured, not performing reflection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと洋一おじさんと釣りに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went fishing with Dad and Uncle Yoichi.
lines.style: Warm, genuine small laugh underneath. Direct, unhurried. Pride in the activity itself, not in telling it. The natural ease of a child sharing something real that happened.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお友達の博之さんとお茶会されてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was having tea with his friend Hiroshi.
lines.style: Observational, domestic. Slight smile in the tone — noticing and relaying the moment. Pace is easy, unhurried. The voice of someone comfortable in her knowledge of the household.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと一夫おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad and Uncle Kazuo today.
lines.style: Open, straightforward delivery. Bright but not loud. The simple pleasure of recounting what he did. Small pause before the name, like he's making sure he says it right.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「僕達は家族だから助け合おう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying we should help each other because we're family.
lines.style: Gentle, purposeful. Slower pace on the idea itself. Warm undertone — this is something she wants him to hear and remember. Tender but not sentimental; this matters to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「身がわりとも書く「みがわり」を教えて頂いたよ」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me a word — 'migawari,' it means someone who substitutes for you, like a stand-in.
lines.style: Eager, slightly proud. Quick tempo. Leaning forward in the voice — this is new knowledge he's excited to share. Careful pronunciation of the word, wanting to get it exactly right.
